opinions.text: Appeal from the Supreme Court of Georgia. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 361 U. S. 807.) The motions of Railway Labor Executives’ Association and the American Federation of Labor and Congress of Industrial Organizations for leave to file briefs, as amicus curiae, are granted.
